inventory: Le groupe de Galois de K...
notes: The page introduces the integer ring as an algebra and an associated ring scheme, its unit group scheme, E and E^0, then a proposed description involving the abelianized Galois group and Pic(A). The author writes “vérifier ce pt.” beside the quotient and connected-component instruction. He then writes “semble être” for G^0=A*/R, defining R by closure of the unit sections and discussing its generic fibre. These are recorded as his formulations, without a proof check of the class-field or motivic claims. The ink reads “absolues”, not the alternative positives supplied by H. The small bound between α and r_1 is newly marked as strict/non-strict uncertainty; no mathematical expectation has supplied an extra equality stroke. In the second quotient the argument is literally Z×R*, with no hat on Z; that expression is retained together with the cancelled earlier argument. Archive number 158.
doubts: Nearly upright compressed stroke; separate equality rule not discernible.
Dense diagonal hatching covers the main symbol; Q is lower right.
Initial c and descending p survive, much of ending is covered.
notation: Double underline consistently denotes the scheme letters.
hand: The initial ab in absolues has a low a and a tall b; H’s positives has no matching initial p descender.
Calligraphic R has several left loops and a curved right leg; H read N, but the bowl and leg recur in both occurrences.
Retracing in sections does not cross the word with an independent cancellation stroke.
extra: Certainty-only: On and schéma are resolved. Cancelled composante remains doubtful after crop scan 159 (807,1112,997,1179). The paper-clip outline at the upper left is a physical mark, not a manuscript drawing.
